FAQs

What is the format of the call?

Get personalized guidance in a 30-minute video session with a certified Notion expert. You'll receive hands-on support tailored to your specific needs, whether you're just getting started or looking to optimize your workspace.

Who will I be meeting with?

You'll connect with a certified Notion consultant who has extensive experience helping organizations successfully implement and optimize their workspaces. Our experts do not work at Notion, but have worked with dozens of teams across various industries, providing practical guidance for both startups and established companies.

How much does this session cost?

Your 30-minute session is completely free! This is part of our commitment to helping teams succeed with Notion. If you find value in the session and want to explore more in-depth support, you can discuss additional consulting options with your expert.

Can I invite other members of my team?

Absolutely! We encourage team participation to maximize the value of your session. Multiple perspectives can help ensure we address all your team's needs and questions. To make the most of your 30-minute session, we recommend:

  • Preparing your key questions in advance

  • Having your Notion workspace ready to share

  • Identifying specific challenges you'd like to address
